visual_identity.color_palette: Pale mint-green skin with soft lavender-purple dappled spots concentrated along the neck and upper back; smooth cream-colored underbelly.
visual_identity.texture: Leathery skin with subtle specular highlights and organic pebbled scales.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: Small, friendly head with large expressive eyes; an exceptionally long, tapering tail held in a gentle curve off the ground.

anatomy_constraints.neck: Extremely long, slender neck spanning nearly 50% of the total body length; designed for a wide horizontal sweep.
anatomy_constraints.limbs: Massive pillar-like legs with thick, rounded feet and blunt claws.
anatomy_constraints.body: Large, heavy-set sauropod frame with a deep chest and sloping back.

visual_logic.subject: A calm, immense Mamenchisaurus foraging with a rhythmic movement.
visual_logic.action: Standing among lush green mossy banks, its neck sweeping across a wide arc to reach high-canopy ginkgos.
visual_logic.environment: Background features the Shaximiao formation palette of grayish-green vegetation and a deep blue river with a rocky bed.

personality: The 'Gentle Giant'—stoic, immensely powerful, and moves with a thundering but composed pace.
